binary_prefix.coverage: Every 9-bit South word and every Boolean 1- or 2-bit prepended prefix; dropped high South bits independently varied.
binary_prefix.one_hot_error_boundary: 00,10,01 satisfy weighted error<=2; 11 gives 3 and must be excluded.

cyclic_witness.coverage: All pairs of aligned cells for every N in 1..32, including the singleton cycle; validates the exact theta difference witness, not only existence.
